description: DREAL Pays de la Loire: storm and wind hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Pays de la Loire. Coverage: DREAL Pays de la Loire. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about storm and wind hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Dégradations linéaires lors de la tempête Xynthia sur le littoral des ; Brèches consécutives à la tempête Xynthia identifiées sur le littoral ; Surface terrestre submergée lors de la tempête Xynthia sur le littoral; Laisses de mer lors de la tempête Xynthia sur le littoral des Pays de . Formats seen: ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
